GDAL layer class

Source: R/vector.R
GDALLayer.Rd

S7 class wrapping an OGRLayer. A layer belongs to the dataset it came from, and stops working when that dataset is closed.

Usage

GDALLayer(.ptr = NULL)

Arguments

.ptr

Internal. External pointer to the underlying GDAL object.
